summary: Composer command palette. ui/Palette.kt (new): PaletteTrigger decides from a composer edit whether to open a palette — '/' typed into an empty message opens the command palette, '@' typed at a word start opens the file picker (only a single appended character counts, so pasting or editing never opens one; steering text never does); base() drops the '/word' that opened the palette before a resource is prepended, attach() replaces the opening '@' with the file reference. CommandPalette (ModalBottomSheet, shown while the existing resources reader is open): the host's resources (skills '/skill:name' and templates '/name', the slash input the host runs remotely) with paging, reload (when advertised) and refresh-on-error, choosing one rewrites the draft without sending; while the composer can send, the desktop commands (DesktopCommands, the 43 names of COMMAND_SPECS in src/slash.rs, guarded by a test that reads that file) each either mapped to the phone control that covers it (/new -> New session confirmation, /model /models /reasoning -> Model panel, /diff -> Diff page, /session -> Sessions page, /history -> Conversation history, /attach -> File picker, /reload -> Reload resources; enabled by the same read/control policies) or disabled and marked 'Desktop only'. FilePalette (ModalBottomSheet, shown while the files reader is open): parent directory, directories navigate, attachable files insert the quoted '@"path"' reference, paging, refresh-on-error. ui/Composer.kt: the text field raises the triggers through the existing resources(-1) / files('.') reads; the two leading buttons ('Select host resource', 'Attach host file') open the same palettes. ui/dialogs/BrowserDialogs.kt (ResourcesDialog, FilesDialog) removed; the palettes keep their content descriptions and test tags.

notes: Deviations / decisions: (1) Owned paths ui/Composer.kt and ui/Palette.kt (new). Also touched: ui/ConversationScreen.kt (renders the palettes instead of the dialogs), ui/dialogs/BrowserDialogs.kt deleted, new JVM tests PaletteTest and screenshot PaletteScreenshotTest, two new instrumented tests appended to ResourceCatalogScreenTest and WorkspaceFilesScreenTest. (2) No protocol was added: the remote protocol has no operation that lists or runs the desktop's built-in slash commands (remote prompts expand only host resources), so the palette lists the host's resources from the existing resources_list read and shows the built-in commands from a phone-side table checked against src/slash.rs at test time; commands without a phone control are disabled and marked 'Desktop only' instead of being sent. (3) Triggers fire only for a single typed character ('/' in an empty composer, '@' at a word start), never for pasted text, and never while steering. (4) Choosing a palette entry never sends; it edits the draft (resource, file) or hands over to the existing page/sheet/dialog (commands).
